title: Fest3
tagline: The first ever events App focused on Web3 events that allows payments in Crypto and reputational NFTs for the attendees and hosts.
description:
Introducing "Fest3" – The Premier DApp for Web3 Experiences

Fest3 is a groundbreaking web application designed to revolutionize the way we pay and participate in Web3 events. As the very first platform of its kind, Fest3 seamlessly integrates the power of blockchain technology, cryptocurrency payments, decentralized ID, and reputational NFTs to create an unparalleled event experience for attendees and hosts.

🔑 Key Features:

💰 **Crypto-Powered Simplicity:** Embrace the future of transactions with the convenience of cryptocurrency payments. Say farewell to outdated payment methods as Fest3 empowers attendees to effortlessly register for events using their preferred cryptocurrencies. 

🔑 **World ID - Your Passport to Anonymously Verified Identity:** Embrace the future of identity verification with World ID, a one-of-its-kind digital passport that validates your uniqueness and authenticity while preserving your anonymity. Say farewell to intrusive personal data requests; with World ID, you can securely access Fest3, revealing your true identity only when necessary, ensuring both your privacy and security.

🚀 **Optimism Network Integration:** Our EventsWeb3 App harnesses the power of Optimism's Layer 2 scaling solution to deliver lightning-fast interactions, making your event interactions smoother and more efficient than ever before.

🔒 **Reputational NFTs - Eternalize Your Presence:** Commemorate your participation in Web3 events with our unique Nestable Reputational NFTs, meticulously crafted using the innovative RMRK EVM NFT standards. This introduces an unprecedented dimension to our event experience, offering an interface for Nestable Non-Fungible Tokens with a unique focus on granting the parent token unprecedented control over the intricate relationships within.

📅 **Seamless Event Registration:** Effortlessly sign up for Web3 events using your World ID, streamlining the registration process like never before. With just a few clicks, you can secure your spot at gatherings, knowing that your World ID protects your personal information while ensuring a genuine and engaging event experience.
how_its_made:
- How we built it:
    1. The idea was laid out on Notion for all team members to see it, afterwards, we had a Google Meeting and agreed on the terms.
    2. The smart-contract flow was created, and we decided to deploy on Optimism due to its compatibility with World ID
    3. Parallel to the creation of the smart-contract flow, the design was done in Figma https://www.figma.com/file/kJCogiEQukK3xObnjpdgfO/Fest3-App?type=design&node-id=262%3A23324&mode=design&t=gAx7OBoA5sRq3eHD-1 
    4. After the design was in a sketch stage, the front-end started to work on it, especially on the WorldID integration which was the most challenging

What we did:

Successfully verified contract Fest3 on Etherscan. - Buy Tickets function added


Fest3 - https://goerli-optimism.etherscan.io/address/0xaC07b8787D3e3897511e67f66DB9E1199B6188bE#code

Profile - https://goerli-optimism.etherscan.io/address/0x39128d85a6df75a7440cf407ad2eafe58eb1b962#code

When the user verifies himself using the Worldid app, it will generate a zk proof. You can call the verifyAndCreateProfile function of the Fest3 contract so that our contract can verify it on chain and mint users profile with +3 reputation points.
